normative.facts: ILP32 int/long/pointer=4 bytes, long long/double=8 bytes, standard procedure stack alignment=16 bytes; RV32 size_t is unsigned int; scalar ABI and permitted ISA instructions are separate.
-march controls permitted target instructions, -mabi selects integer/floating argument convention; names/prefixes alone do not establish selected ISA.
FENCE.I synchronizes local instruction fetch with preceding visible stores; it is not a general DMA completion or data-cache maintenance service.
RV32 counter halves require a consistent read; execution environment must supply counter rate. A cycle count has no intrinsic ns unit.

note: Normative entries are paraphrased source notes, not toolchain measurements or target conformance certification. Web pages may change; fixed ISA version used where available.
